book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Conscience, at those intervals, may smite him for his living without prayer, without reflection, without God in all his thoughts ; and what is his remedy ?
claim: 양심은 기도, 반성, 하나님에 대한 생각 없이 살아가는 사람을 책망할 수 있다.

author: Andrew Fuller

source_text: No, nor so much as promise to forsake it immediately : but this he promises ; that, when this busy time is over, and that favourite point is gained, and those intricate affairs are terminated^ then it shall be otherwise.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is thus with the drunkard and the debauchee: wearied in their own way, they intend to lead a new life, as soon as they can but shake off their old connexions.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: In short, it is thus with great numbers in all our towns and vil- lages and congregations : they put off the great concern to anoth- er time, and think they may venture, at least, a little longer ; till all is over with them, and a dying hour just awakens them, like the virgirs in the parable, to bitter reflection on their own fatal
claim: 많은 사람들이 중요한 문제를 나중에 생각하고, 조금 더 시간을 끌 수 있다고 생각하지만, 결국에는 모든 것이 끝나고 죽음의 순간에 비로소 자신의 운명을 후회하게 된다.

claim_raw: 그리스도와 인류의益을 위한 큰 또는 좋은 일을 시작하는 것을 막는 것은 회심하지 않은 사람들에게만 영향을 미치는 것이 아니라 모든 사람에게 영향을 미친다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: We see many things that should be done ; but there are difficulties in the way, and we wait for the removal of these difficulties.
claim: 우리는 해야 할 일을 많이 보지만, 그 사이에 어려움이 있고, 우리는 이러한 어려움이 제거되기를 기다린다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: We are very apt to indulge a kind of prudent caution, (as we call it,) which foresees and magni- fies difficulties beyond what they really are.
claim: 우리는 실제보다 더 큰 어려움을 예상하고 확대하여 조심스러운 주의를 취하는 경향이 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is granted, there may be such things in the way of an undertaking, as may render it impracticable ; and, in that case, it is our duty, for the present, to stand still : but it becomes us to beware, lest we account that impracticable which only requires such a degree of exertion as we are not inclined to give it.
claim: 우리는 종종 실제보다 더 어려운 것으로 예상하고 과장하는 유익한 주의를 취할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But is not this like ceiling our own houses; while the house of God lies waste ?
claim: 하나님의 집을 돌보는 것보다 자기 집을 먼저 돌보는 것은 잘못된 우선순위이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Perhaps it requires concur- rence ; and we wait for every body to be of a mind, which is never to be expected.
claim: 모두가 동의하기를 기다리다 보면 결코 이루어지지 않는 일이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: He who, through a dread of opposition and re- proach, desists from known duty, is in danger of being found among the fearful, the unbelieving, and the abominable.
claim: 하나님께로부터 주어진 의무를 수행하는 데 반대와 비난을 두려워하여 그 의무를 중단하는 사람은 두려움에 사로잡힌 자, 믿지 않는 자, 그리고 가증스러운 자 중에 발견될 위험에 처해 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Had Luther and his cotemporaries acted upon this principle, they had never gone about the glorious work of the Reformation.
claim: 루터와 그의 동시대 사람들이 이 원칙을 따랐다면 그들은 종교 개혁의 영광스러운 일을 결코 시작하지 않았을 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If the chief priests and rulers, in different nations, would but unite, something might be effected ; but what can /do, an individual, and a poor man ?
claim: 개인이나 가난한 사람이 권력자들의 지지 없이도 변화와 개혁을 일으킬 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I may render myself an object of persecution, or which is worse, of universal contempt ; and what good end will be answer- ed by it ?' Had Luther reasoned thus ; had he fancied, that, be- cause princes and prelates were not the first to engage in the good work, therefore the time was not come to build the house of the Lord ; the house of the Lord, for any thing he had done, might have lain waste to this day.
claim: 개인이 자신의 신념을 위해 행동할 때, 권력자들의 반대나 조롱에 직면할 수 있지만, 그것이 올바른 일을 하는 것을 방해해서는 안 된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Instead of waiting for the removal of difficulties, we ought, in many cases, to consider them as purposely laid in our way, in order to try the sincerity of our religion.
claim: 우리는 어려움을 제거하기를 기다리는 대신, 종교의 진실성을 시험하기 위해 우리의 길에 의도적으로 놓인 것처럼 많은 경우에 어려움을 고려해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: He who had all power in heaven and earth, could not only have sent forth his apostles into all the world4 but have so ordered it that all the world should treat them with kindness, and aid them in their mission ; but, in- stead of that, he told them to lay their accounts with persecution, and the loss of all things.
claim: 하나님이 모든 권능을 가지고 계시지만, 그분은 사도들을 위해 모든 세계가 친절하게 대하고 그들의 사명을 돕도록 하지 않으셨고, 대신 그들에게 박해와 모든 것을 잃을 것을 준비하라고 말씀하셨다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: This was, no doubt, to try their sincer- ity; and the difficulties laid in our way are equally designed to try ours.
claim: 하나님은 우리의 진실성을 시험하기 위해 우리의 길에 어려움을 두신다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Let it be considered, whether it is not owing to this principle, that so few and so feeble efforts have been made for the propaga- tion of the gospel in the world.
claim: 복음의 세계적인 전파에 대한 노력의 부족은 특정 원칙에 기인한다

author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: When the Lord Jesus commission- ed his apostles, he commanded them to go and teach all nations, to preach the gospel to every creature ; and that, notwithstanding the difficulties and oppositions that would lie in the way.
claim: 주 예수께서 사도들에게 복음을 전하라고 명하셨을 때, 모든 민족에게 가서 복음을 전하고 모든 피조물에게 복음을 선포하라고 하셨으며, 어려움과 반대에도 불구하고 그렇게 하라고 하셨다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Ought we not, then, at least, to try, by some means, to convey more of the good news of salvation to the world around us, than has hitherto been con- veyed ?

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Were every true minister of the gospel to make a point of preaching, as often as possible, in the villages within his reach ; and did those private Christians who are situated in such villages open their doors for preaching, and recommend the gospel by a holy and affectionate behaviour ; might we not hope to see the wilderness become as a fruitful field ?
claim: 복음의 전파를 위해 모든 진정한 복음의 사명자가 가능한 한 자주 마을에서 설교하고, 마을에 사는 기독교인들이 성도적인 행동으로 복음을 추천한다면, 황무지도 결실 많은 들로 변할 수 있을 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Sure- ly, in these matters we are too negligent.
claim: 우리는 복음 전파에 대해 너무 소홀하다.

author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: And when we do preach to the unconverted, we do not feel as if we were to do any good.

claim_raw: 우리는 未회심자에게 설교할 때 효과를 기대하지 않는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Is it not owing, at least a considerable degree of it, to a notion we have, that the time is not come for any thing considerable to be effected ?
claim: 우리가 생각하는 바와 같이, 아직 중요한 일을 이루기 위한 때가 오지 않았다는 생각이 우리에게 영향을 미친다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Yet there are many who consider themselves as Christians, and are considered so by others, who still live in the neglect of these ordinances.
claim: 많은 사람들이 스스로를 기독교인으로 생각하지만, 세례와 성만찬과 같은 교회의 규례들을 소홀히 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I speak not now of those who con- sider themselves as having been baptized in their infancy, but of such as admit the immersion of believers to be the only true bap- tism, and yet do not practise it, nor hold communion with any par- ticular church of Christ.
claim: 일부 기독교인들은 믿는 이들의 침례만이 참된 침례라고 인정하지만 실제로 침례를 받지 않거나 교회와 교제하지 않는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is painful to think, there should be a description of professed Christians who live in the neglect of Christ's commands.
claim: 그리스도인의 명령을 무시하는 자칭 기독교인들이 존재하는 것은 고통스럽다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Probably they are various : there is one, however, that must have fallen under your observation; that is, the want of some powerful impression upon the mind, impelling them, as it were, to a compli- ance.
claim: 인간은 강한 영적 감동이나 충격이 없이는 신앙의 순종에 나아가지 않는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects

claim_raw: 교회의 성도들이 영적이고 애정있고 평화로운 공동체라면 목사님의 사역이 기쁨으로 이루어지지만, 世俗적이고 다투는 성도들이라면 목사님의 사역은 어려움을 겪을 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: To settle their minds on this subject, Jeremiah, the prophet, addres- sed the following letter to them, in the name of the Lord : Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom T have caused to be carried away from Jeru- salem unto Babylon, Build ye houses, and dwell in them ; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them ; take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters ; and take wives for your sons, and give your daugh- ters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters ; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished : and seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the Lord for it; for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
claim: 하나님은 바빌론에 포로로 잡혀간 이스라엘 백성에게 평화와 번성을 약속하셨다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Revenge, in such circumstances, must have seemed natural ; and, if a foreign invader, like Cyrus, had placed an army before their walls, it had been excusable, one would have thought, not only to have wished him success, but, if an opportu- nity had offered, to have joined an insurrection in aid of him : yet nothing like this is allowed.
claim: 유대인들이 바빌론에 포로로 잡혀간 상황에서 Cyrus의 도움을 받거나 반란에 참여하는 것은 자연스러웠을 것이라고 생각할 수 있지만, 성경은 이런 행동을 허용하지 않는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: When Cyrus actually took this great city, it does not appear that the Jews did any thing to assist him.
claim: 유대인들은 바빌론을 정복한 키루스에게 도움을 주지 않았다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Their duty was to seek the welfare of the city, and to pray to the Lord for it, leaving it to the great Disposer of all events to deliver them in his own time ; and this, not merely as being right, but wise : In their peace ye shall have peace.
claim: 유대인들의 의무는 도시의 복지를 추구하고 주님께 그 도시를 위해 기도하는 것이었으며, 그들을 자신의 시간에 구원해 줄 대로 모든 사건의 큰 배치자에게 맡기는 것이었고, 이것은 단순히 옳은 것이 아니라 지혜로운 것이었다.
claim_raw: 유대인들의 의무는 도시의 복지를 추구하고 주님께 그 도시를 위해 기도하는 것이었으며, 그들을 자신의 시간에 구원해 줄 대로 모든 사건의伟大한 배치자에게 맡기는 것이었고, 이것은 단순히 옳은 것이 아니라 지혜로운 것이었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

claim: 우리는 우리의 조국, 즉 우리의 조상들이 묻혀 있는 땅, 우리를 보호하는 온화하고 건강한 법률이 부왕 같은 왕 아래 시행되는 땅, 시민적이고 종교적인 자유가 다른 곳보다 더 높은 수준으로 즐기는 땅의 복을 추구해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Inquire into the duty of religious people towards their country.
claim: 종교인들은 자신의 국가에 대한 의무를 조사해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Though, as Christians, we are not of the world, and ought not to be conformed to it ; yet, being in it, we are under various obligations to those about us.
claim: 그리스도인으로서 우리는 세상을 향한 다양한 의무를 가지고 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: As husbands, wives, pa- rents, children, masters, servants, lie. we cannotbe insensible that others have a claim upon us, as well as we upon them; and it is the same as members of a community united under one civil govern- ment.
claim: 크리스천들은 가족과 사회 구성원으로서 서로에게 책임을 지고 의무를 다해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If we were rulers, our country would have a serious claim upon us as rulers ; and as we are subjects, it has a serious claim upon us as subjects.
claim: 국가와 사회에 대한 책임과 의무를 인식해야 한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The ground on which our Saviour refused to let his servants fight for him, that he should not be delivered into the hands of the Jews, was, that his was a kingdom not of this world ; plainly intimating, that if his kingdom had been of this world, a contrary line of conduct had been proper.
claim: 예수님의 왕국이 이 세상이 아닌 것과는 반대로, 세속적인 왕국에서는 자기 나라를 지키기 위해 무력을 사용하는 것이 옳다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Now, this is, what every other kingdom is : it is right, therefore, according to our Lord's reasoning, that the subjects of all civil states should as such, when required, fight in defence of them.
claim: 주님의 논리에 따르면 모든 세속적 국가의 신민들은 그 국가를 방어하기 위해 싸울 의무가 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Has not Christianity, I ask, in the most decided manner, recog- nized civil government, by requiring Christians to be subject to it ?
claim: 기독교는 기독교인들이 그것에 복종하도록 요구함으로써 민간 정부를 명백하게 인정한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Has it not expressly authorized the legal use of the sword ?
claim: 기독교는 법적 권위를 인정하고, 검을 사용하는 것을 허용한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Christians are warned that the magistrate beareth not the sword in vain ; and that he is the minister of God, a revenger, to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
claim: 그리스도인들은 권위자가 악을 저지르는 자에게 진노를 집행하기 위해 하나님의 사자로서 검을 가지고 있으며, 이는 헛되지 않다는 것을 경고받았다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But, if it be right for the magis- trate to bear the sword, and to use it upon evil doers within the realm, it cannot be wrong to use it in repelling invaders from with- out : and, if it be right on the part of the magistrate, it is right that the subject should assist him in it : for, otherwise, his power would be merely nominal, and he would indeed b,ear the sword in vain.
claim: 국가의 권위자로서의 재판관이 악을 저지르는 자에게 진노를 집행하는 것은 옳으며, 이에 협력하는 것은 주체의 의무이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Whatever is the duty of one, allow- ing for different talents and situations in life, is the duty of all.
claim: 모든 사람에게는 각자의 재능과 상황에 따라 다르지만, 하나의 의무가 존재한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If, therefore, it be not binding upon the former to unite in every necessary measure for the support of civil government, neither is it upon the latter : and if it be binding upon neither, it must fol- low, that civil government itself ought not to be supported, and that the whole world should be left to become a prey to anarchy or despotism.
claim: 시민 정부의 지원에 대한 의무는 모든 사람에게 동일하게 적용되며, 이를 지키지 않으면 혼란이나 전제주의로 빠질 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Farther : If the use of arms were, of itself, and in all cases^ inconsistent with Christianity, it were a sin to be a soldier: but nothing like this is held out to us in the New Testament.
claim: 기독교와 무기 사용은 모든 경우에 반드시 모순되는 것이 아님

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: On the contrary, we there read of two believing centurions ; and nei- ther of them was reproved on account of his office, or required to relinquish it.
claim: 기독교 신앙과 무력 사용은 모든 경우에 모순되는 것이 아니며, 신약 성경에서 두 명의 믿는 백인대장(centurions)이 언급되며, 그들의 직책으로 인해 비난받지 않았거나 그 직책을 포기하라는 요구를 받지 않았다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: We also read of publicans and soldiers who came to John to be baptized, each asking, What shall we do?
claim: 세례 요한에게 세례를 받으러 온 세리와 군인들은 각자 직업의 남용에 대해 경고를 받았지만, 직업 자체는 합법적인 것으로 간주되었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The answer to both proceeds on the same principle : They are warned against the abuses of their respective employments ; but the employments themselves are tacitly allowed to be lawful.
claim: 요한의 세례에 참여한 세리와 군인들에게 주어진 답변은 그들의 직업 자체는 합법적이지만, 직업의 남용에 대해 경고받았다는 원칙에 기반한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Exact no more than that which is appointed you: to the other, Do violence to no man^ neither accuse any falsely, and be content with your wages.
claim: 요한은 두 사람에게 각기 다른 지시를 하였다. 하나에게는 정해진 것을 초과하지 말라고 하고, 다른 사람에게는 사람에게 폭력을 행사하지 말고, 거짓으로 고소하지 말고, 임금에 만족하라고 했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If either of these occupations had been, in itself, sinful, or inconsistent with that kingdom which it was John's grand object to announce, and into the faith of which his disciples were baptized, he ought on this occasion, to have said so, or, at least, not to have said that which implies the contrary.
claim: 요한의 침례는 그의 제자들이 믿음을 가지고 왕국을 선포하는 것과 관련이 있으며, 그 직업이나 활동이 죄가 되거나 그 왕국과 모순된다면 요한은 그것을 말해야 했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If it be objected, that the sinfulness of war would not lie so much at the door of the centurions and soldiers as of the govern- ment by whose authority it was proclaimed and executed ; I allow there is considerable force in this : but yet, if the thing itself were necessarily, and in all cases, sinful, every party voluntarily concerned in it must have been a partaker of the guilt, though it were in different degrees.
claim: 전쟁의 잘못은 정부의 권위에 의해 선언되고 실행되는 것에 더 많이 있을 수 있지만, 전쟁 자체가 필연적으로 모든 경우에 잘못이라면, 모든 관련 당사자는 다른 정도로 잘못의 공유자가 될 것이다.
claim_raw: 전쟁의 죄는 정부의 권위에 의해 선언되고 실행되는 것에 더 많이 леж을 수 있지만, 전쟁 자체가 필연적으로 모든 경우에 죄라면, 모든 관련 당사자는 다른 정도로 죄의 공유자가 될 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But, granting, it may be said, that war is not, in itself, necessa- rily sinful ; yet it becomes so by the injustice with which it is commonly undertaken and conducted.
claim: 전쟁은 본질적으로 죄가 아니지만, 일반적으로 부정의한 방식으로 수행되므로 죄가 된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But, if wars be allowed to be generally undertaken and conducted without a regard to justice, it does not follow that they are always so ; and still less that war itself is sinful.
claim: 전쟁이 항상 정의롭지 않더라도 전쟁 자체가 죄라는 것은 아님

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: In as- certaining the justice or injustice of war, we have nothing to do with the motives of those who engage in it.
claim: 전쟁의 정의 또는 부정의를 결정할 때, 우리는 전쟁에 참여하는 사람들의 동기를 고려할 필요가 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The question is, Whether it be in itself unjust?
claim: 전쟁의 정의 또는 부정의는 그에 참여하는 사람들의 동기에 관계없이 결정된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Be- fore we condemn any measure as unjust, we ought to be in posses- sion of the means of forming a just judgment concerning it.
claim: 어떤 조치를 불공정하다고 판단하기 전에, 우리는 그것에 대해 공정한 판단을 내릴 수 있는 정보를 가지고 있어야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: How much less, then, are we able to judge of the differences of nations, which are generally not a little complex, both in their origin and bearings ; and of which we know but little, but through the chan- nel of newspapers and vague reports !
claim: 국가 간의 차이점을 판단하는 것은 매우 어렵다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is disgusting to hear people, whom no one would think of employing to decide upon a common difference between two neighbours, take upon them to pronounce with the utmost freedom, upon the justice or injustice of national differences.
claim: 국가 간의 분쟁이나 문제에 대해 일반인들이 쉽게 판단하거나 의견을 내서는 안 된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Where those who are constitutionally ap- pointed to judge in such matters have decided in favour of war, however painful it may be to my feelings, as a friend of mankind I consider it my duty to submit, and to think well of their decis. ion, till by a careful and impartial examination of the grounds of the contest, I am compelled to think otherwise.
claim: 국가 간의 분쟁에서 전쟁을 결정한 헌법적으로 임명된 판단자들의 결정을 따르는 것이 개인의 도덕적 의무이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: After all, there may be cases in which injustice may wear so prominent a feature, that every thinking and impartial mind shall be capable of perceiving it ; and where it does so, the public sense of it will and ought to be expressed.
claim: 명백한 부정의 경우에는 모든 생각이 있고 공정한 사람들은 그것을 인식할 수 있으며, 그러한 경우에는 대중의 감정은 표현되어야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Without taking upon me to decide on the original grounds of the difference; the question at issue with us is, 7s it right that any one nation should seek absolutely to ruin another, and that other not be warranted, and even obliged to resist it ?
claim: 어떤 국가도 다른 국가를 완전히 파괴하려고 시도하는 것은 옳지 않으며, 그 다른 국가가 저항할 권리와 의무를 가지는 것이 정당하다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: That such is the object of the enemy, at this time, cannot be reasonably doubted.
claim: 현재 적의 목적은 다른 국가를 완전히 파괴하는 것이라는 것이 합리적으로 의심할 수 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If my country were engaged in an attempt to ruin France, as a nation, it would be a wicked undertaking ; and if I were fully convinced of it, I should both hope and pray that they might be disappointed.
claim: 국가의 파괴는 악한 일이며, 나는 그런 일에 반대하며 실패를 바란다.
claim_raw: 국가의 파괴는 악한事業이며, 나는 그런事業에 반대하며 실패를 바란다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But there is another duty which we owe to our country ; which is, That we pray to the Lord for it.
claim: 우리는 우리의 국가를 위해 주님께 기도하는 의무를 가지고 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is supposed that religious people are a praying people The godly Israelites, when carried into Babylon, were banished from temple-worship ; but they still had access to their God.
claim: 종교인들은 기도하는 사람들이어야 한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The devotional practice of Daniel was well known among the great men of that city, and proved the oc- casion of a conspiracy against his life.
claim: 다니엘의 경건한 실천은 바빌론의 유명한 사람들 사이에서 잘 알려져 있었고, 그의 생명에 대한 음모를 일으키는 계기가 되었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: My brethren, your country claims an interest in your's ; and I trust that if no such claims were preferred, you would, of your own accord, remember it.
claim: 신자들의 기도는 그들의 국가를 위한 관심을 요구한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You are aware that all our dependence, as a nation, is upon God; and, therefore, should importune his assistance.
claim: 하나님의 도움을 간구해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: After all the struggles for power, you know that in his sight all the inhabit- ants of the world are reputed as nothing : he doth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth ; and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou ?
claim: 하나님은 하늘나라와 땅 위의 모든 존재를 그의 뜻대로 다스리시며, 그의 손길을 막거나 그의 행동에 대해 질문할 수 있는 이는 아무도 없다.
claim_raw: 하나님은 천국과 지上的 모든 존재를 그의 뜻대로 다스리시며, 그의 손길을 막거나 그의 행동에 대해 질문할 수 있는 이는 아무도 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Indeed this has been acknowledged, and, at times, sensibly felt, by irreligious characters ; but, in general, the great body of a nation, it is to be feared, think but little about it.
claim: 많은 사람들이 하나님의 주권을 생각하지 않는다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Their depen- dence is upon an arm of flesh.
claim: 인간의 의지나 능력에 대한 의존은 신뢰할 수 없는 것임을 인정한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It may be said, without uncharita- bleness, of many of our commanders, both by sea and land, as was said of Cyrus, God hath girded them, though they have not known him.
claim: 많은 지도자들은 하나님을 알지 못하면서도 하나님의 도우심을 받았다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The prayer of the righteous man availeth much.
claim: 의인의 기도는 큰 힘을 가지고 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You are also aware, in some measure, of the load of guilt that lies upon your country ; and should, therefore, supplicate mercy on its behalf. 1 acknowledge myself to have much greater fear from this quarter, than from the boasting menaces of a vain man.
claim: 국가의 죄에 대한 책임을 인식하고, 그에 대한 자비를 구해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If our iniquities provoke not the Lord to deliver us into his hand, his schemes and devices will come to nothing.
claim: 하나님의 심판을 피하기 위해서는 우리의 죄가 하나님을 우리를 적의 손에 넘기도록 격발하지 않는다면, 적의 계획과 계략은 무위로 돌아갈 것이다.
claim_raw: 하나님의 심판을 피하기 위해서는 우리의 죄가 하나님을 우리를 적의手に 넘기도록 격발하지 않는다면, 적의 계획과 계략은 무위로 돌아갈 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: When we have fasted and prayed, I have seemed to hear the voice of God, saying unto us, Loose the bands of wickedness, undo the heavy burdens, let the op- pressed go free, and break every yoke !
claim: 하나님은 우리에게 악의 결박을 풀고, 무거운 짐을 덜어주고, 압제받는 자를 자유롭게 하며, 모든 멍에를 깨뜨리라고 말씀하신다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Yet, peradventure, for his own name's sake, or from a regard to his own cause, which is here singularly protected, the Lord may hearken to our prayers, and save us from deserved ruin.
claim: 하나님의 이름과 그의 사역을 위해 우리의 기도를 들으사 우리를 당한 파멸에서 구원하실 수 있다.
claim_raw: 하나님의 이름과 그의 사역을 위해 우리의 기도를 들으사 우리를 заслуж된 파멸에서 구원하실 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: We know that Sodom itself would have been spared, if ten righteous men could have been found in her.
claim: 소돔에서도 의로운 사람들이 10명이라도 있었다면 소돔은 파괴되지 않았을 것이라는 사실을 우리는 알고 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The Lord hath so wisely and mercifully interwoven the inter- ests of mankind, as to furnish motives to innumerable acts of justice and kindness.
claim: 인간의 이익을 지혜롭고 자비롭게 얽어 만든 주님은 수많은 정의와 친절한 행동에 대한 동기를 제공한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: We cannot injure others, nor even refrain from doing them good, without injuring ourselves.
claim: 우리는 다른 사람에게 피해를 주거나, 혹은 그들에게 선을 행하지 않음으로써 스스로에게도 피해를 준다.
claim_raw: 우리는 다른 사람에게 피해를 주거나, 혹은 그들에게 善을 행하지 않음으로써 스스로에게도 피해를 준다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If no other considerations will induce us to protect our country, and pray to the Lord for it, our own individual and domestic comfort might suffice.
claim: 개인과 가정의 안녕을 위해 국가를 보호하고 하나님께 기도해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: To this may be added, our interests as Christians, no less than as men and as families, are interwoven with the well-being of our country.
claim: 그리스도인으로서의 우리의 이익은 우리나라의 번영과 밀접하게 관련되어 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects

author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You know (I speak to them who read the bible) that the seed of the woman was to bruise the head of the serpent.
claim: 여자의 후손이 뱀의 머리를 상처를 입힐 것이라고 성경에 기록되어 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You know that God promised Abraham, saying, in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed.
claim: 하나님은 아브라함에게 모든 땅의 민족이 그의 씨를 통해 복을 받을 것이라고 약속하셨다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You know that Jacob, when blessing the tribe of Judah, predicted the coming of Shiloh, unto whom the gather- ing of the people should be.
claim: 야곱은 유다 지파를 축복할 때 실로가 오는데 모든 백성이 모여들 것이라고 예언했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You know that Moses spake of a prophet that the Lord your God should raise up from the midst of you, like unto him, to whom you were to hearken, on pain ofincur- ing the divine displeasure.
claim: 모세는 하나님께서 너희들 중에서 일으키실 선지자에 대해 말하였고, 이 선지자는 모세와 같은 존재이며, 이 선지자에게 순종하지 않으면 하나님의 분노를 사게 된다고 하였다.
claim_raw: 모세는 하나님께서 당신們 중에서 일으키실 선지자에 대해 말하였고, 이 선지자는 모세와 같은 존재이며, 이 선지자에게 순종하지 않으면 하나님의 불쾌를 사게 된다고 하였다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You know that the Messiah is prophet- ically described in the Psalms, and the prophets, under a great va- riety of forms particularly as the anointed of the Lord — the King — the Lord of David, to whom Jehovah spake — the child born> whose name should be called the mighty God, the everlasting Father, the
claim: 메시아는 성경에서 여러 형태로 예언적으로 묘사되며, 주님의 기름 부음 받은 자, 다윗의 주인, 여호와께서 말씀하신 자, 강력한 하나님, 영원한 아버지라는 이름으로 불리는 아기로 묘사된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Prince of Peace — the rod out of the stem of Jesse — God's servant, whom he upholds ; his elect, in whom his soul delighteth — him whom man despiseth, and whom the nation abhorreth — a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief — the Lord our righteousness — Messiah the prince — the branch — the messenger nf the covenant, &c. &c.
claim: 예수 그리스도는 평화의 왕이자 이사야의 가지에서 나온 지팡이로서 하나님의 종이며 하나님의 영이 기뻐하는 선택된 자이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The time when Messiah should come is clearly marked out in prophecy.
claim: 메시아의 오시는 시기는 예언으로 분명히 표시되어 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It was said by Jacob, when blessing the tribes, The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a law-giver from between his feet, until Shiloh come ; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
claim: 야곱은 축복의 말에서 메시아가 오기 전까지 유다 지파에서 권세와 법을 주관하는 자가 나올 것이라고 말했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: All this was true in respect of Jesus.
claim: 예수에 대한 모든 것이 참이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Till he came, though the ten tribes were scattered, Judah continued a people, and retained the government ; but soon after his death, they were dispersed among the nations, and have been so ever since.
claim: 예수님이 오신 후 유대인들이 흩어져서 각국에 퍼져 살게 되었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: " Kings and princes,'7 says one of your own writers, " we have none." If therefore, Shiloh be not come, he can never come within the limits of time marked out by this prophecy.
claim: 실로가 오지 않았다면, 그는 시간의 한계 내에서 결코 오지 않을 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Again: It is clearly intimated, in the prophecy of Haggai, for the encouragement of the builders of the second temple, that the Messiah should come during the standing of that temple ; and that the honour that should be done it by his presence would more than balance its inferiority, in other respects, to the first.
claim: 메시아는 두 번째 성전이 서 있는 동안에 오실 것이며, 그의 현현으로 인해 성전의 다른 점들에서 열등함이 상쇄될 것이라고 하가이 선지자에 의해 암시된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land : and I will shake all nations ; and the desire of all nations shall come ; and I will fill this house with glory saith the Lord of hosts.
claim: 메시아는 두 번째 성전이 서 있는 동안에 오실 것이며, 그의 존재로 인해 성전은 영광을 받을 것이라고 예레미야 선지자에 의해 암시되었다.
claim_raw: 메시아는 두 번째 성전이 서 있는 동안에 오실 것이며, 그의 присensemce로 인해 성전은 영광을 받을 것이라고 하게리 선지자에 의해 암시되었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the Lord of hosts.
claim: 하나님은 모든 재물의 주인이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the Lord of hosts.
claim: 후자의 집의 영광이 전자의 집보다 더 클 것이라고 주님께서 말씀하셨다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: All this was literally fulfilled in Jesus.
claim: 예수님을 통해 하신 말씀의 약속이 실제로 이루어졌습니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Jesus was not the Messiah, it is impossible that the prophecy should ever be accomplished.
claim: 예수님이 메시아가 아니라면 예언이 이루어질 수 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Again : The prophet Daniel was informed by the angel Gabriel as follows : Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people, and upc/i thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the Most Holy.
claim: 다니엘 선지자는 가브리엘 천사로부터 70주의 기간이 그의 백성과 성도에게 정해졌으며, 그 기간은 범죄를 끝내고 죄를 없애고 불의에 대한 속죄를 이루고 영원한 의를 가져오고 비전과 예언을 봉인하며 거룩한 이를 기름 부음으로써 완성한다는 것을 알려받았다.
claim_raw: 다니엘 선지자는 가브리엘 천사로부터 70주의 기간이 그의 백성과 성도에게 정해졌으며, 그 기간은 범죄를 끝내고 죄를 없애고 불의에 대한 속죄를 이루고 영원한 의를 가져오고 비전과 예언을 봉인하며 至聖者를 기름 부음으로써 완성한다는 것을 알려받았다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Know, therefore, and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem, unto the Messiah the prince, shall be seven weeks : and threescore and two weeks, the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.
claim: 메시아가 나타나기까지 7주가 걸리고, 그 후에 62주 동안 거리와 성벽이 다시 건축될 것

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary ; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.
claim: 메시아는 62주 후에 자기를 위해 죽임을 당할 것이며, 그 후에 성전과 성읍이 파괴될 것이고, 그 전쟁의 끝까지 황폐가 계속될 것임을 알라

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week; and in the midst (or half part) ef the week, he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease ; and for the over- spreading of abominations, he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the deso- late.
claim: 메시아는 한 주 동안 많은 사람과 약속을 확인할 것이며, 주 중간에 제사와 예물을 중단시키고, 가증스러운 것들이 퍼짐으로 말미암아 황폐하게 할 것이며, 결정된 것이 황폐한 곳에 쏟아질 때까지 vậy리라.
claim_raw: 메시아는 한 주 동안 많은 사람과 언약을 확인할 것이며, 주 중간에 제사와 예물을停止시키고, 가증스러운 것들이 퍼짐으로 말미암아 황폐하게 할 것이며, 결정된 것이 황폐한 곳에 쏟아질 때까지 vậy리라.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: That there should be some difficulty in fixing the dates, and other minute particulars, in this prophecy is no more than may be said of many others, which yet, upon the whole, are clear and de- cisive.
claim: 예언의 날짜와 세부 사항을 확정하는 데 어려움이 있을 수 있지만, 전체적으로는 명확하고 결정적이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The prediction of the seventy years captivity was not un- derstood by Daniel till he had studied the subject with attention • and, though he made out the number of the years, and concluded that they were about fulfilled, yet be does not appear to have discovered the exact time of their being so.
claim: 다니엘은 주의70년 포로 예언을 연구하고 주의년에 대한 숫자를 파악했지만, 정확한 시간을 알지 못했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Nevertheless, the prophecy of seventy years was undoubtedly fulfilled in the Baby- lonish captivity ; and this of seventy weeks of years is as cer- tainly fulfilled in the appearance and death of Jesus.
claim: 예언된 70년과 70주의 예언은 각각 바빌론 포로기와 예수님의 출현 및 죽음에서 확실하게 이루어졌다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Whether, or not, Christian writers agree as to the exact time when these * seventy sabbatical weeks, or four hundred and ninety years, began, thus much is certain, that they must have been fulfilled about the time that Jesus appeared and suffered, or they never can be fulfil- led.
claim: 예수님의 출현과 죽음으로 70주의 예언이 반드시 이루어졌으며, 그렇지 않으면 결코 이루어질 수 없다는 것

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Such was the effect of this and other prophecies upon the minds of the Jewish nation, that about that time there was a gen- eral expectation of the Messiah's appearance.
claim: 유대 민족은 메시아의 등장에 대한 일반적인 기대를 가지고 있었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The predicted events which were to be accomplished at the close of these weeks, name- ly, finishing transgression, making an end of sins, making recon- ciliation for iniquity, bringing in everlasting righteousness, sealing up the vision and prophecy, and anointing the Most Holy, are in perfect harmony with the New Testament history of Jesus ; and, though unbelief m«y blind the minds of your nation to some o* (hem, yet, the sealing up of the vision and prophecy is a matter so notorious, that one would think it were impossible to deny it.
claim: 예수님의 삶과 죽음은 구약의 예언을 완성하였고, 그 결과로 예언과 계시는 폐쇄되었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Je- sus foretold the destruction of your city and temple by the Ro- mans ; and his apostles foretold things relating to the Christian church ; but from that time your nation has been, not only * with- out a king, without a prince, and without a sacrifice,' but without a prophet.
claim: 예수님과 그의 사도들은 유대인 도시와 성전의 파괴, 그리고 그 이후 유대인 민족의 상황에 대해 예언하였다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Moreover, it is predicted by Daniel, that shortly after the Mes- siah should be cut off, the people of the prince that should come would destroy the city and the sanctuary, and that the end thereof should be desolation.
claim: 다니엘은 메시아가 죽은 후에 곧 그 메시아의 백성이 올 사람의 백성에 의해 성과 성소가 파괴되고 그 끝이 황폐가 될 것이라고 예언했다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: And is it not fact, that about forty years after the death of Jesus, both your city and sanctuary were de- stroyed by the Romans; and that such a flood of desolation and misery attended it, as was unexampled in your history, or that of any other nation ?
claim: 예수님의 죽음 약 40년 후에 로마인들이 예루살렘과 성소를 파괴하고, 그 결과로 엄청난 황폐와 고통이 찾아왔으며, 이는 유대인 역사나 다른 민족의 역사에서 찾아볼 수 없는 일이었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Taking the whole together, it behoves you to consider, wheth- er, if this prophecy be not fulfilled in Jesus, it can ever be ful- filled ; and whether it be possible to ascertain the fulfilment of any prophecy.
claim: 예수 안에서 이루어지지 않는다면 이 예언이 언제든지 이루어질 수 있는지 그리고 어떤 예언의 성취를 알 수 있는지 고려해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The place where Messiah should be born, and where he should principally impart his doctrine, is determined.
claim: 메시아의 출생지와 주로 그의 교리를 전파할 곳이 결정되어 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Jud.ih, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel ; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlast- ing.
claim: 베헤미야 에브라타에서 메시아가 나올 것이며, 그분은 이스라엘의 통치자가 될 것이라는 약속이 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: These prophecies were literally and manifestly fulfilled in Jesus ; and it is scarcely credible that they can be ful- filled in any other.
claim: 예언은 예수님에서 문자적으로 그리고 분명하게 성취되었으며, 다른 곳에서 성취될 수 있다는 것은 거의 믿을 수 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The house, or family from whom Messiah should descend, is clearly ascertained.
claim: 메시아는 특정한 집안 또는 가족에서 내려오실 것이라는 것이 분명하다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: So much is said of his descending from Da- vid, that I need not refer to particular proofs ; and the rather, as no Jew will deny it.
claim: 메시아는 다윗의 집에서 내려오실 것이라는 사실이 분명하다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The genealogies of Matthew and Luke, whatever varieties there are between them, agree in tracing his pedigree to David.
claim: 마태와 누가의 족보는 다양한 차이에도 불구하고 다윗에게로 그의 계보를 추적하는 데 동의한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: And though, in both, it is traced in the name of Joseph, jet this appears to be only in conformity to the Jewish custom of tracing no pedigree in the name of a female.
claim: 마태와 누가의 족보는 요셉의 이름으로 계보를 추적하지만, 이는 유대인의 풍습에 따라 여성의 이름으로 계보를 추적하지 않는 것에 따른 것으로, 실제로는 마리아의 계보가 추적되고 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The fa- ther of Joseph, as mentioned by Luke, seems to have been his father by marriage only ; so that it was, in reality, Mary's pedi- igree that is traced by Luke, though under her husband's name ; and this being the natural line of descent, and that of Matthew the legal one, by which, as a king, he would have inherited the crown, there is no inconsistency between them.
claim: 누가복음에서 요셉의 아버지가 언급된 것은 사실상 마리아의 계보를 요셉의 이름으로 추적한 것으로 보인다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But, whatever supposed difficulties may, at this distance of time, attend the genealogies, it is remarkable that no objection .appears to have been made to them in the early ages of Christianity; when had they been incorrect, they might easily have been disproved by the public registries which were then in being.
claim: 초기 기독교 시대에는 족보에 대한 반대 의견이 없었으며, 족보가 부정정할 경우 당시 존재했던 공공 기록으로 쉽게 반증할 수 있었을 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Could the Jews in the time of Jesus have disproved his being of the seed of David, his Messiahship would at once have fallen to the ground ; and for this they could not be wanting in inclination.
claim: 예수님이 다윗의 후손이라는 사실을 유대인들이 반증할 수 있었다면, 그의 메시아로서의 지위는 즉시 무너졌을 것이다.

claim: 성도들은 자신의 마음과 대화하면 의문이나 행동에서 나타난 의심이 사실임을 알 수 있다.
claim_raw: 성도들은 자신의 마음과 대화하면疑問이나 행동에서 나타난 의심이 사실임을 알 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You have acted, but in too many instances, as though you doubted whether you were ac- countable and immortal creatures ; and as though an agreeable subsistence in the present world were the only thing that should concern you.
claim: 인간은 책임을 지고 불멸의 존재이며, 현재 세계의 쾌적한 존재만이 관심을 가질 것이 아님을 알면서도 행동하지 않는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But, if you be not accountable to him that made you, how is it that sin, which is unknown to every creature but yourself, should, nevertheless, be accompanied with remorse ?
claim: 만약 인간이 창조주에게 책임을 지지 않는다면, 왜 죄는 후회를 동반하는가?

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Is there not a tribunal erected within your own bosom, that forebodes a judgment to come.
claim: 인간의 내면에는 미래의 심판을 예감하는 내재된 법정이 존재한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If there were no hereafter, why that dread of death, and that fearful looking-for of judgment, in the hour of threatening affliction ?
claim: 만약 내세가 없다면, 죽음에 대한 두려움과 심한 고난의 때에 심판을 두려워하는 이유는 무엇인가?

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Oh sinner ! you shall not be able to plead ignorance at the bar of heaven : your own heart, depraved as it is, will bear witness against you.
claim: 죄인들은 천국에서 무지함을 변명할 수 없을 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: There are things to which you are apt to object, in God's deal, ings with you, which, were you tc commune with your own hearts* would be found to be unobjectionable.
claim: 하나님께서 우리와 상호작용하는 방식에 대해 우리가 반대하는 것들은, 우리가 자신의 마음과 소통한다면 비난받을 것이 없을 것입니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If you are told of the strictness of God's holy law, and that nothing short of truth in the hiward parts can answer to its requirements, you think it hard, and feel disposed to complaiu of thegrievousness of his yoke : but ask your own hearts, would you be contented with any thing less from a fellow-creature ?
claim: 하나님의 거룩한 법의 엄격성과 그 요구에 대한 진실한 응답이 필요함에도 불구하고, 사람들은 하나님의 멍에가 가혹하다고 생각하고 불평하는 경향이 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Perhaps you are a parent, or a master ; and what if your chil- dren or servants were, through fear, ever so assiduous; if you knew they had no love for you, would you be satisfied ?
claim: 자녀나 하인들이 두려움으로 인해 매우 부지런하게 행동한다고 해도, 그들이 자신을 사랑하지 않는다면, 그것으로 만족할 수 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If the partner of your life were alienated from you, and attached to another, though, through fear of your displeas- ure, she were studious to the utmost to oblige you in her outward deportment, would this satisfy you ?
claim: 외적인 행동만으로는 만족하지 못하고, 상대방의 마음을 얻는 것이 중요하다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Would you not disdain to accept of her services, unless you could have her heart with them ?
claim: 진정한 만족은 외적인 행동뿐 아니라 상대방의 마음이 함께 할 때에만 얻을 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Out of your own mouth therefore, will the Lord judge you.
claim: 주님은 당신의 입에서 나오는 말로 당신을 판가름하실 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Again : If you are told of God's awful threatenings against sin, your spirits rises against him, and you are ready to accuse him of cruelty : but ask your own heart, if you would spare one that had treated you as you hate treated him ?
claim: 하나님의 심판에 대한 경고를 들었을 때, 사람들은 하나님을 잔인하다고 비난하는 경향이 있지만, 자신이 받은 대로 하나님께 행한 것과 같은 대가를 자신이 받는다면 어떻게 할 것인지 물어보면, 그들은 자신의 잘못을 인정할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If you had a son, and, with all the tenderness of a father, nursed him, fed him, clothed him, and instructed him ; and if, when he arrived at years of maturity, instead of behaving towards you with filial obedience and gratitude, he should prove undutiful, malignant, false, and do all he could to ruin you and your family, would you not give him up to his evil courses, and let him take the consequences of his behaviour ?
claim: 하나님은 죄에 대한 엄청난 위협을 하실 때, 우리의 영이 그에게 반발하며, 그분을 잔인하다고 비난할 수 있지만, 우리가 그분에게 행한 것과 같은 방식으로 우리를 대우한 자를 우리가 용서할 수 있을지 자아성찰해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Alas, all this, and a thousand times more, have you done against the best of Fathers, the God in whose hands your breath is, and whose are all your ways !
claim: 인간은 하나님께 대하여 죄를 짓고, 하나님의 섭리와 도움을 받았음에도 불구하고, 다시 이전의 죄악된 길로 돌아가는 경향이 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal.
claim: 하나님의 길은 공의로우나 인간의 길은 불공평하다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Hear now, O house of Is- rael, Is not my way equal ? are not your ways unequal ?
claim: 하나님의 길은 공평하지만 인간의 길은 불공평하다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: One reason of your knowing so little of your heart-sins is, your communing so little with your hearts.
claim: 마음과 소통하지 않기 때문에 당신은 당신의 마음의 죄에 대해 거의 알지 못한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You go on in a hurry of business, and the state and temper of your heart is overlooked ; and, being naturally disposed to flatter yourself, you imagine it to be much better than it is.
claim: 인간은 자신의 내면 상태를 제대로 알지 못하고, 스스로를 과대평가하는 경향이 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You may be governed by the love of this world, yea, and be very covetous; so much so, that all who know you may perceive it ; and yet you do not perceive it yourself, but are ready to be offended with any person who tells you of it.
claim: 세상적인 사랑과 탐욕에 사로잡혀 있을 수 있지만 스스로는 그것을 인식하지 못할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You think yourself as good as your neighbours, and flatter yourself that your sin is not so very great. ' It is true,' say you, ' I have my failings, as all men have, bat, thank God, I never was guilty of
claim: 인간은 자신의 죄를 과소평가하고 자신을 이웃과 비교하여 죄가 크지 않다고 생각한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: There is one thing in particular, which, perhaps, never struck attention, your total want of love to God.
claim: 하나님에 대한 사랑의 결핍이 있다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: This is the sin of your nature, and the fruitful parent of all other sins.
claim: 인간의 본성의 죄는 하나님에 대한 사랑의 결핍이며, 이것이 모든 다른 죄들의 근원이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: God requires the whole heart; as, indeed, he justly may, for he is worthy of it; but you have no heart to give him.
claim: 하나님은 온 마음을 요구하시며, 당신은 하나님께 드릴 마음이 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is preoccupied, and that with such things as are contrary to God.
claim: 인간의 마음은 하나님께 드릴 수 있는 마음이 없으며, 이미 다른 것들로 채워져 있고 그것은 하나님께 대적하는 것들이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: All your actual sins are but little, compared with this.
claim: 실제적인 죄들은 비교적 작지만, 하나님께 반대되는 것에 대한 집착은 훨씬 더 크다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Those are the fruits ; but this is the poisonous root from which they spring.
claim: 세상과 세상의 것들을 사랑하는 것은 하나님을 사랑하지 않는 것에서 비롯된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If you loved God, you could not love the world, and the things of the world, as you do.
claim: 하나님을 사랑한다면 세상을 사랑할 수 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You could not blaspheme his name, neglect his worship, or trample on his laws ; and all with unconcern.
claim: 하나님을 사랑한다면, 하나님의 이름을 모독하거나, 그의 예배를 소홀히 하거나, 그의 법을 짓밟는 등과 같은 행동을 무감각하게 할 수 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Neither could you feel towards your neighbour as you do in many instances.
claim: 하나님을 사랑하는 사람은 그의 형제도 사랑할 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: All bitterness, and wrath, and malice, and evil speaking ; all envy to- wards them that are above you, and pride, oppression, and unfeel- ing treatment, towards them that are beneath you ; all arise from a want of the love of God ; for he that loveth God, will love his brother also.
claim: 하나님을 사랑하는 자는 그의 형제도 사랑할 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: All unconverted sinners, I believe, retain a good opinion of their hearts, however they may differ in expressing it : which is evident- ly owing to>their ignorance of its deceitfulness and desperate wick- edness.
claim: 개종하지 않은 죄인들은 모두 자기 마음에 대한 좋은 의견을 가지고 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Some make no secret of it. ■ It is true,' say they, ' I now and then swear, when in a passion, and get too much liquor once in a while ; but I mean no evil ; my heart is good.' Others who have been brought up under evangelical preaching, are ashamed of this language, and would despise the ignorance of the person who should use it.
claim: 회심하지 않은 죄인들은 자기들의 마음이 선하다고 생각한다.
claim_raw: 未회심한 죄인들은 자기들의 마음이 선하다고 생각한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: They will not deny in words that their kearts are bad ; howbeit they mean not so.
claim: 일부 사람들은 자신의 마음이 나쁘다는 것을 말로는 부정하지 않지만, 그들의 의미는 다르다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I love Christ j but I wish T did.' This is the same thing as saying, 4 My heart is good.
claim: 그리스도를 사랑하지만 더 사랑하기를 원한다는 것은 내 마음이 선하다는 것을 의미한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If I be not a converted man, it is not my fault.
claim: 구원은 인간의 노력에 의해 달성될 수 없으며, 하나님의 주권적 행위에 달려 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I am wil- ling at any time, if God would but convert me.' But all this is false and delusive.
claim: 인간은 하나님의 개입 없이는 스스로 개종할 수 없다는 것

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If you were willing to return to God, by Jesus Christ, there k nothing in heaven or earth that stands in your way.
claim: 만약 당신이 하나님께로 돌아가려는 의지가 있다면, 예수 그리스도를 통하여, 하늘이나 땅에 당신을 방해하는 것은 아무 것도 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The truth is, }Ou love your sins too well to part with them for Christ or heaven ; and have no desires after conversion for its own sake, but merely as a something, which, at times, you think you could submit to, rather than suffer eternal damnation.
claim: 사람들은 그리스도와 천국을 얻기 위해 죄를 버리기를 원하지 않으며, 오직 영원한 저주를 피하기 위해 회심을 생각할 뿐이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Whoever neglects t<» commune with his own heart, it is necessary for you, that you may know your true character ; of which, with all your advantages, you are hitherto totally ignorant.
claim: 자기 자신의 마음과 교제하지 않는 사람은 자신의 진정한 성품을 알기 위해 자기 반성을 해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Even in the concerns of men with men, there is much blindness to their own motives, and deception in forming a judgment of their own conduct ; which is owing to a want of looking into themselves.
claim: 인간은 자신의 동기와 행동에 대해 자아 성찰을 하지 않으면 자신의 진정한 의도와 행동을 올바르게 판단하지 못한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: A thousand things are defended by persons, in company, which, were they to retire alone, and commune with their own hearts, they 7vould be obliged to condemn.
claim: 인간은 종종 혼자 있을 때 자신의 행동을 반성하여 비난받을 수 있는 것을 사회적 상황에서 옹호한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: In how many instances have con- tentions been cherished, and half a neighbourhood either brought in as witnesses, or in some way implicated in the contest, which might all have been decided in a quarter of an hour, if the party had only retired alone, and asked himself this question : Have I done to my neighbourwhat I should have wished him, in like circumstan- ces, to have done to rae ?
claim: 개인들은 혼자 있을 때 자신의 행동을 되돌아보고, 이웃에게 자신이 받고 싶은 대로 대했다는 질문을 던질 때, 많은 분쟁들이 쉽게 해결될 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: There are things on account of which you may value your- selves, and of which you may make a righteousness-, that, if you were to retire alone, would be found of a very opposite nature.
claim: 외부적으로 보이는 의식이나 행동이 실제로는 옳지 못한 본성을 가릴 수 있다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is possible, likewise, that you may consider this as the way to heaven, and, from hence, lay your account with being happy in the world to come.
claim: 외적인 종교 행실만으로는 구원에 이를 수 없으며, 하나님의 승인을 받을 수 있는 동기가 필요하다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But, if you look into your heart, you may find that the motives which have influenced you have been such as God can never approve ; and, if so, instead of justifying.
claim: 하나님의 승인을 받을 수 없는 동기가 인간의 행동을 영향할 수 있다
claim_raw: 하나님의 승인을 받을 수 없는 동기가 인간의 행동을影响할 수 있다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: they will serve only to condemn you.
claim: 그런 행동들은 오직 너를 단죄하기만 할 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If you have read the scrip- tures, or gone to a place of worship, merely from custom, and not from any love you had to these things ; if you have relieved the poor out of pride, rather than pure compassion; and if that which has preserved you from the grossest vices has been rather a regard to your interest, health, or character, than any concern for the ho- nour of God ; can such things be acceptable in his sight ?
claim: 하나님의 눈앞에서 외적인 종교 행위나 관습이 순수한 동기 없이 행해진다면 그것은 받아들여지지 않는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But, if your motives were ever so pure, and your good deeds ever so many; yet, having broken the holy, just, and good Jaw of God, you cannot be justified by any thing which you can do.
claim: 인간의 순수한 동기와 많은 선행에도 불구하고, 하나님의 거룩하고 올바른 법을 어긴 자는 자신의 행동에 의해서는 올바르다 할 수 없다.
claim_raw: 인간의 순수한 동기와 많은 선행에도 불구하고, 하나님의 거룩하고 정의로운 법을 어긴 자는 자신의行为에 의해서는 의롭다 할 수 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If you commune with your heart to any good purpose, you will never think of being saved by the works of your own hands ; but feel the necessity of a Saviour, and of a great one.
claim: 구원은 오직 하나님의 은혜와 구원자에 의해서만 가능하다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The doctrine of salva- tion by the death of Jesus will be glad tidings to your soul.
claim: 예수님의 죽음으로 말미암는 구원의 교리는 영혼에게 기쁜 소식이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects

claim: 신령적으로 상처받은 영혼은 하나님의 자비와 그리스도 예수님을 신뢰함으로써 치유되고 행복해질 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: We have seen even religious characters inordinately depressed with troubles.
claim: 종교적인 사람들조차도 어려움으로 인해 비정상적으로 우울해질 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The loss of some darling object, the confounding of some favourite scheme, or the rising of some apparently insur- mountable difficulty, has overwhelmed the heart.
claim: 어떤 소중한 대상을 잃거나, 좋아하는 계획이 무너지거나, 극복할 수 없는 어려움이 발생하면 마음이 압도될 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: In such cir- cumstances, the mind is apt to nurse its melancholy, trying to live, as it were, on dying elements : but it is not thus that we shall eith- er glorify God, or gain relief.
claim: 어려운 상황에서 마음이 우울함에 빠져있을 때, 하나님을 영화롭게 하거나 안위를 얻는 것이 아님을 인정해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Jesus hath said, Let not your heart be troubled ; ye believe in God, believe also in me.
claim: 예수님은 우리에게 마음을 괴롭히지 말라고 말씀하셨다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: From troubles of some kind there is no exemption; in the present state : but it does not become the followers of Christ to indulge in /tearMroubles for little things; and such are all our worldly sorrows; light afflic- tions wiiicharebut for a moment.
claim: 그리스도인의 삶에서 작은 일에 대한 근심은 피해야 하며, 모든 어려움은 기도와 감사로 하나님께 드려야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The true Christian life is, to be inordinately careful for nothing ; but is every things by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, let our requests be made known unto God.
claim: 진정한 기독교인의 삶은 아무것도 걱정하지 않는 것이며, 모든 것을 기도와 감사로 하나님께 알려주는 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is thus that the peace of God, which passeth all un- derstanding, shall keep our hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
claim: 하나님의 평화는 우리의 마음과 생각을 그리스도 예수님을 통해 지키는데, 이는 모든 이해를 초월하는 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is by ceasing to take counsel, in our souls, and trusting in God's mercy, that our sorrow, like that of David, will be turned into joy and triumph.
claim: 우리는 하나님의 자비를 신뢰하고, 우리의 영혼에서 조언을 그치면, 우리의 슬픔이 다윗의 슬픔처럼 기쁨과 승리로 바뀔 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Our way may be covered with darkness, so much so, that we cannot see where the next step will place us : but we have a Leader, who sees through all, and who has promised to guide us with his eye.
claim: 우리의 길이 어둠으로 덮여 있어 다음 발걸음이 어디에 닿을지 볼 수 없더라도, 우리는 모든 것을 꿰뚫어보는 지도자와 함께 하며, 그분은 우리를 그의 눈으로 인도하실 것이라고 약속하셨다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Things may so work, as to confound our calculations : but, if all work together for good, this is sufficient.
claim: 하나님의 섭리가 모든 것을 선으로 인도하므로 우리의 계산이나 계획이 어지러워도 충분하다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: What are our afflictions, too, in comparison of the glory that awaits us ?
claim: 우리가 겪는 고난은 우리가 기다리는 영광에 비해 비교할 수 없을 정도로 작다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Paul had his afflictions, as well as we, far greater indeed than ours have been ; and he also took counsel under them ; but not with himself : he took into his account the hope that was set before him : I reckon says he, that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory that shall be re-
claim: 바울은 자신의 고난을 경험했지만, 앞에 있는 소망을 고려하여 그것을 대처했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is while we thus look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen, that our afflictions appear light and momentary, and work for us afar more exceeding and eternal weight of glory.
claim: 우리는 보이는 것보다 보이지 않는 것을 바라볼 때 우리의 고난이 가볍고 일시적이며, 영원한 영광의 무게를 우리에게 더 크게 작용한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The case of the Psalmist is applicable to persons who, at the outset of their religious concern, are encompassed with darkness and long continued dejection.
claim: 일부 사람들은 초기의 종교적 관심에서 어둠과 장기간의 우울로 둘러싸여 있지만, 성도들은 이러한 경험을 통해 구원에 이를 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: There are some, who are no sooner brought to entertain a just sense of the nature an;! demerits of sin, than they are led to embrace the gospel- way of salvation, and find rest to their souls : but it is not so with all.

claim_raw: 모든人が 죄의 본질과 잘못을 깨닫고 곧바로 복음의 구원 방식을 받아들이고 영혼의 안식을 찾는 것은 아님

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Some are known to continue, for a long time, in a state of dark suspense.
