claim_raw: 어떤 사람들은 죄의 본질과 그 잘못에 대한 올바른 인식을 갖게 된 후 곧 복음의 구원 방식을 받아들이고 영혼에 안식을 찾지만, 모든 사람이如此하지는 않으며, 어떤 사람들은 오랜 시간 동안 어둠과 불확실성의 상태에 머무른다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: They have too deep a sense of sin to be able to enjoy the pleasures of this world ; and are too much in the dark concerning its forgiveness, to be able to imbibe the joys of another.
claim: 죄에 대한 깊은 감각으로 인해 이 세상의 즐거움을 즐길 수 없으며, 죄의 용서에 대한 불확실성으로 인해 내세의 기쁨도 맛보지 못한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Hence, their days are spent in solitude and dejection : they search for peace, but it is fir from them : they take counsel in their soul, and have sorrozv in their heart daily.
claim: 죄에 대한 깊은 감각과 죄 사함에 대한 불확실성으로 인해 이 세상의 즐거움을 즐길 수 없으며, 평화를 찾지만 그것이 멀리 떨어져 있으며, 영혼에서 조언을 구하고 마음에 매일 슬픔을 경험한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Perhaps, like David, they had no friend to whom they could open their minds ; or if they had, it might have been to persons who were either total strangers to these things, or who were unskilful in the word of right- eousness.
claim: 어떤 사람들은 다윗처럼 마음을 열 수 있는 친구가 없을 수 있으며, 만약 친구가 있다 해도 그들은 의로운 말씀에 익숙하지 않거나 그에 대한 지식이 부족할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Such also may have been the kind of preaching they have heard, that nothing suitable to their case has been ordinarily, if ever, delivered.
claim: 적절한 영적 지침이나 설교를 듣지 못한 사람들은 영적 어려움을 겪을 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If the preacher be of such a description as to content himself with moral harangues ; if, instead of exhibiting the Saviour of sinner«, he have nothing to say to a wounded spirit, un- less it be to advise him to forsake his vices, and be better ; or if his object be rather to improve the manners of men, and render them decent members of society, than to renew their hearts ; the ten- dency of his preaching will be, either to establish the hearer in pharisaical presumption or sink him into despondency.
claim: 성도들에게 적절한 복음적 메시지를 전달하지 못하는 설교는 청자를 위선적인 자만이나 절망으로 이끌 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Or, should the preacher be of another description ; should he hold forth a kind of Mahometan predestination ; be averse from the free invitations of the gospel to sinners, as sinners; and employ himself in persuading his hearers that no one has any warrant to come to Jesus for eternal life, but the regenerate : the effects will
claim: 일부 설교자는 마호메탄식의 예정론을 주장하며, 죄인으로서 죄인들을 자유롭게 초청하는 복음의 초대에 반대하며, 재생한 사람만이 예수께 영생을 얻기 위해 오는 것이 정당하다고 설교하는 경향이 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The awakened sinner will either take up with some enthusiastic impression, imagine himself a favourite of heav- en, trusting that he is righteous . and despising others ; or, having no consciousness that he is regenerate, be deterred from approach- ing the Saviour, and so sink into despondency.
claim: 각성한 죄인은 열정적인 인상에 매이거나 자신이 하늘의 특혜를 받았다고 생각하여 의롭다고 믿고 다른 사람을 경시하거나, 재생된 것에 대한 의식이 없어서 구세주께 접근하기가 주저하여 절망에 빠지게 된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Could I gain access to such a character, I would proclaim in his ear the mercy of God to sinners ; the all-sufficiency and willing- ness of Jesus to save all that are willing to be saved by him ; and the free invitations of the gospel ; as a sufficient warrant for him, or any other sinner, to trust his immortal interests in his hands.
claim: 하나님의 자비와 예수님의 구원 의지, 그리고 복음의 자유로운 초청은 죄인들이 예수를 통해 구원받을 수 있는 충분한 보증이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: O ye that labour and are heavy laden, come to Jesus, and ye shall Jindrest unto your souls !
claim: 지치고 무거운 사람들은 예수께로 와서 영혼의 안식을 찾을 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Do not dream of first ascertaining your election, or regeneration, and of approaching the Saviour as a fa- vourite of heaven ; it is only by believing in him, as a perishing sinner, that you can obtain an evidence of these things.
claim: 구원받기 위해서는 먼저 선택이나 재생에 대한 확신을 얻으려는 것이 아니라, 멸망하는 죄인으로서 예수님을 믿어야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is by the gospel coming to us, not in word only, but in power, that our election of God is known, and our regeneration ascertained.
claim: 하나님의 선택과 우리의 새 생명은 복음이 우리에게 말만으로 오지 않고 능력으로 오는 것을 통해 알려진다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: In others, such dejection may be owing to something within them.
claim: 어떤 사람들의 낙심은 그들 안에 있는 어떤 것에서 기인할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It may arise from a kind of propensity to think on things which are against them, rather than on those which are in their favour ; viewing only the dark side of the cloud ; dwelling on the magnitude of their guilt, their unworthiness of mercy, and the little success they have had in praying and striving to enter in.
claim: 어떤 사람들의 낙심은 자신에게 불리한 것들에 대한 생각을 하려는 성향에서 비롯될 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: This propensity is often fed by an idea that it would be presumption, in such sinners as they are, to admit the consolation of the gospel ; and that it is abundantly more becoming them to stand aloof, in darkness and misery.
claim: 어떤 죄인들은 복음의 위안을 받는 것이 거만한 것으로 생각하여 어둠과 고통 속에서 머무는 것이 더 적절하다고 믿는다.
claim_raw: 어떤 죄인들은 복음의 위안을 받는 것이傲慢한 것으로 생각하여 어둠과 고통 속에서 머무는 것이 더 적절하다고 믿는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But this is not Christian humility.
claim: 그리스도인의 겸손은 구원의 위안을 받는 것을 주저하는 것이 아니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is a spurious kind of modesty, the principle of which is nearly akin to that voluntary humility and self-denial, that induces men to abstain from that which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving.
claim: 그리스도인의 겸손은 자발적인 겸손과 자신을 부인하는 것과는 다르며, 하나님이 감사와 함께 받으라고 창조하신 것을 받는 것을 회피하는 것이 아니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Notwithstanding the modest and humble appearance which these objections assume, they will be found to be no better than a species oj self -righteous pride, opposed to the humiliating gospel of Christ.
claim: 겉으로는 겸손하고 겸손한 모습을 보이지만, 실제로는 자아옳은 자존심으로 나타나며, 그리스도의 겸손한 복음에 반대된다.
claim_raw: 겉으로는 겸손하고謙遜한 모습을 보이지만, 실제로는 자아옳은 Pride로 나타나며, 그리스도의 겸손한 복음에 반대된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

claim: 복음의 축복을 받기 위해 자격이 없다고 생각하는 것은 자의적인 교만에 근거한 것일 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: these blessings, you must be worthy of them, at least somewhat more so than you are at present?
claim: 성도들은 받은 축복에 합당한 존재가 되어야 하며, 현재보다 조금 더 그러한 존재가 되어야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But this ip the very essence of self-righteous- ness, and directly opposite to the gospel of Christ.
claim: 자기 의로움은 그리스도의 복음과 정반대이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Christ came into the world to seek anrl save them that are lost.
claim: 그리스도는 잃어버린 자를 찾고 구원하기 위해 세상을 방문했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: He came into the world to save sinners, even the chief of sinners.
claim: 그리스도는 죄인, 특히 가장 큰 죄인들을 구원하기 위해 세상을 방문했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: He has no mercy to bestow on sinners, but as undeserving.
claim: 하나님은 죄인에게 자격이 없는 자로서만 자비를 베푸신다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If any man think himself deserving of his grace, his answer is, / came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
claim: 하나님의 은혜는 자격이 없는 자들에게만 주어지며, 그들은 그 은혜를 받을 자격이 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The very meaning of the word grace, of which the scriptures speak so largely, is free fa- vour to the unworthy : unworthiness, therefore, can be no ground of objection.
claim: 은혜는 가치 없는 자에게 주어지는 자유로운 은총이다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If there be any bar in your way ; it is your conceit of some kind of worthiness being necessary to recommend you to the grace of tbe Saviour : and take heed lest you perish un- der this delusion, after the example of apostate Israel, who followed after the law of righteousness, but never attained it : and where' fore ?
claim: 구원의 은혜를 받기 위해서는 어떤 종류의 가치가 필요하다고 생각하는 자만이 장애물이 될 수 있다
claim_raw: 구원者の 은혜를 받기 위해서는 어떤 종류의 가치가 필요하다고 생각하는 자만심이 장애물이 될 수 있다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law : for they stumbled at that stumbling-stone.

claim: 갈라디아 교회가 그리스도의 교리를 부패시켰을 때, 그들은 증오, 분열, 질투, 분노, 다툼 등에 대해 경고를 받았고, 이러한 일을 하는 자들은 하나님의 나라를 물려받지 못할 것이라고 들었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Doomed as men are to innumerable evils during their short residence upon earth, and to death as the issue, one would think it might excite a sympathy towards each other as fellow-sufferers, and a concern to mitigate, rather than to increase, the miseries of their situation.
claim: 인간은 지상에서 많은 악과 죽음에 처해져 있으므로 서로 동정하고 고통을 줄여야 할 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But when particular cases occur, and the general good is thought to clash with private inter, est, all these reasonings evaporate like smoke, and the lusts which war in the members bear down every thing before them.
claim: 개인적인 이익이 일반적인 선과 충돌할 때, 사람들은 이성적인 판단을 버리고 자신의 욕망에 따라 행동한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The root of the evil lies in our having forsaken God, and become alienated from him.
claim: 인간의 악은 하나님을 떠나고 उसस와 소통하지 못하는 데 근본적으로 있게 된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It was the law of our creation, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and soul, and mind, and strength, and thy neighbour as thyself: and there is a closer con- nexion between these different branches of the law than we aie apt to suppose.
claim: 창조의 법칙은 하나님을 전심으로 사랑하고 이웃을 자기 자신처럼 사랑하는 것이며, 이 두 가지는 밀접한 관련이 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If we love God, we shall love our brother also.
claim: 하나님을 사랑하면 형제도 사랑한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: For a man to fear God, was sufficient to insure a just, kind, and humane treatment of his fellow men.
claim: 하나님을 경외하는 것은 동시에 정의롭고, 친절하며, 인간적인 대우를 받는 것을 보장한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But if we cease to love him. we shall not be able to love one another, unless it be for our own sake.
claim: 하나님을 사랑하지 않으면 다른 사람을 사랑할 수 없으며, 오직 자기 자신의 이익을 위해 사랑할 뿐이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is the love of ourselves only that, in this case, governs us : and this is a principle which, not being subordinate to the love of God, is of the essence of sin, and tends, in its own nature, to fill the world with discord.
claim: 자기 사랑만이 하나님의 사랑에 복종하지 않는 원칙이며, 이는 죄의 본질을 가지고 있고, 본질적으로 세상을 불화로 채우는 경향이 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: small, and some on a larger scale : but, where self love is the mo- tive, every thing is expected to be done for their own honour, in terest, or happiness; and the same thing being expected on the other side, there is no place for concord.
claim: 자기 사랑이 동기라면 모든 것이 자신의 명예, 이익, 또는 행복을 위해 기대되며, 이는 조화를 방해한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If two persons bear an affectionate good will to each other as children of the same family, and each seek the good of the other from the pleasure of doing him good, and without so much as thinking that is is to issue in his own advantage, it will issue in his own advantage ; and that, to a far greater degree than if he had directly sought it : for God has so constituted things, that in seek- ing another's good, we shall find our own.
claim: 하나님의 섭리하심으로 타인의 이익을 구하는 것이 결국 자기의 이익이 된다.
claim_raw: 하나님의 섭리하심으로 타인의益을 구하는 것이 결국 자기의益이 된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If parents and chil- dren, husbands and wives, feel only for themselves, they will re- semble men in a famine, in which no man spareth his brother: one snatches on the right hand, and is hungry : another eats on the left hand and is not satisfied.
claim: 가족 구성원들이 서로의 이익을 위해 노력할 때, 궁극적으로는 각자의 이익도 함께 증가한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But if they feel one for another ; if like the widow of Zarephath by Elijah, each one be willing to di- vide his morsel ; that morsel becomes seven times more sweet, and God often blesses and increases it till the return of plenty.
claim: 가족 구성원들이 서로를 위해 희생하고 나누는 마음을 가지면, 하나님은 그들을 축복하고 풍성함을 회복시킨다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: These remarks are equally applicable to nations, as to individ- uals and families It is owing to self-love having taken place of the love of God, that treaties of alliance and commerce are so fre- quently broken.
claim: 자아 사랑이 하나님 사랑을 대신할 때 국가, 개인, 가족 간의 약속과 상업 조약이 자주 깨진다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: While each party seeks nothing but its own in- terest, and requires that of the other to give place to it, it is impos- sible that concord should be of any continuance.
claim: 자아 사랑이 하나님 사랑을 대신할 때, 각 당사자는 자신의 이익만을 추구하며 상대방에게 양보를 요구하기 때문에, 조화는 지속될 수 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If such leagues be not at once dissolved, it is merely in consideration of the one party hoping to gain, notwithstanding the selfishness of the other, or fearing that greater evils will result from the breach than from the fulfilment of the treaty.
claim: 이기적인 동기가 있는 동맹은 오래 지속될 수 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But unions on so frigid a principle are unworthy of the name.
claim: 자아를 위한 원칙에 기반한 연합은 연합이라는 이름에 합당하지 않다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Nothing can better express it than the words of the Lord by the prophet, Lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.
claim: 하나님의 사랑이 없는 곳에서 자기 사랑이 사회의 모든 부문에서 지배적인 원칙이 되면 모든 것이 파괴를 향해 성숙한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Where the love of God has no place, and self-love is the ruling principle in every department of society, every thing w ripening for destruction.
claim: 하나님의 사랑이 없는 곳에서 자기 사랑이 모든 사회 부문의 지배 원칙이 되면 모든 것이 파괴를 위해 준비되고 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If the whole earth were in this state, it would be like the barren fig-tree, and Heaven would say, Cut it down, why cumbereth it the ground ?
claim: 하나님의 사랑이 없는 곳에서 자기 사랑이 모든 사회 부문의 지배 원칙이 되면 모든 것이 파괴를 향해 성숙해진다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It were better that there should be no world than such a world as this.
claim: 하나님의 심판 아래 존재하는 세계가 전혀 없느니만 못한 상태라면, 그 세계가 존재하는 것보다 전혀 없느니만 좋을 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Consider the inefficacy of all human means for the removal of these evils.
claim: 인간의 모든 수단은 이러한 악을 제거하는 데 효과가 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The miseries produced in the earth by discord are so serious, that it is become the necessary study of the thinking part of mankind to counteract them.
claim: 인간의 모든 수단은 이러한 악을 제거하는 데 효과가 없으며, 생각하는 사람들의 필수적인 연구는 이러한 악을 대처하는 것임을 인식해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Had the love of God ruled in the heart, this had been the cement of the world.
claim: 하나님의 사랑이 인간의 마음을 지배했다면, 그것은 세상을 하나로 묶는 결합제가 되었을 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Had men been ten thousand times more numerous than they are, this would have bound them all together ; but, this principle be- ing extinct, others of a very inferior nature must be substituted in its place.
claim: 하나님의 사랑이 인간의 마음을 지배했다면, 이것이 세상을 하나로 묶는 결합력이 되었을 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is partly by softening the asperities of human na- ture, and partly by cultivating its most pacific principles, that any thing is effected : but though these means may diminish the evil, yet they cannot produc e any thing like a radical cure.
claim: 인간 본성의 온화함과 평화적인 원리의 배양을 통해 악은 감소할 수 있지만 근본적인 치료는 불가능하다
claim_raw: 인간 본性的 온화화와 평화적인 원리의 배양을 통해 악은 감소할 수 있지만 근본적인 치료는 불가능하다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Even harsh things, if expressed in soft and gentle terms, will, in a good degree, loose their harshness, and tend to disarm the party of resentment.
claim: 조금은 거친 말이라도 부드럽고 온유한 말투로 표현하면 그 거친 정도가 많이 줄어들고, 상대방의 분노를 누그러지게 할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: A soft answer turneth away wrath, while grievous words stir up anger.
claim: 부드러운 대답은 분노를 가라앉히고, 가혹한 말은 분노를 일으킨다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But, after all, the change which is hereby effected is nearly confined to the surface of things ; the real temper of the heart is much the same.
claim: 사회적 변화는 표면적인 것에 그치고, 인간 마음의 본질적인 성품에는 큰 차이가 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The most bitter and malignant speeches are uttered without shame by those who reckon themselves gentlemen ; and murder itself is patronized by the laws of honour.
claim: 명예를 이유로 한 살인과 잔인한 발언이 사회에서 용인되고 있다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It were a difficult question to determine, which would be the least friendly to human happiness, for the whole world to be sunk into the lowest state of barbarism, or raised to these haughty and atheistical notions of honour.
claim: 인간의 행복에 대한 최소한의 적개심은 전 세계가 가장 낮은 상태의 야만주의에 빠지거나, 거만하고 무신론적인 명예에 대한 관념에 올라가는 것 중 하나일 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Assuredly, this is not the way in which universal peace will be produced on earth* Another principle to which great things also are ascribed is, a union of interests.
claim: 세계 평화는 다른 원칙에 의해 달성될 것이다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is an undoubted fact, that God, in his provi- dence, has so interwoven the interests of mankind, that they can- not subsist without each other.
claim: 하나님은 그의 섭리 안에서 인류의 이익을 서로 얽어매어 서로에게 의존하지 않을 수 없도록 하셨다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: We talk proudly of indepen- dence ; but we are all dependent, both upon God and one another.
claim: 인간은 하나님과 서로에게 의존한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: These considerations ought, no doubt, to induce mankind, of all ranks, degrees, and situations, to study the things which make for peace : and to say that they actually have no influence in pro- moting concord, would be saying what is manifestly untrue.
claim: 인간은 모든 계층과 상황에서 평화를 위한 요소를 연구해야 하며, 이러한 노력이 조화를 증진하는 데 아무런 영향을 미치지 않는다는 것은 명백히 거짓이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: To this principle we are indebted for the stifling of thousands of quar- rels, which wculd otherwise burst forth, and render society intol- erable.
claim: 인간은 평화와 조화를 위해 노력해야 하며, 이러한 노력은 수천 개의 분쟁을 잠재우고 사회를 더 나은 곳으로 만드는 데 기여한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: To this also we are indebted for the suppression of a ve- ry large portion of religious hatred.
claim: 종교적 증오의 상당 부분이 억제되는 것은 특정 원칙에 기인한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Considering the enmity of wicked men against serious Christians, instead of being surprised at its breaking out so much as it does, we have more reason to be surprised that it breaks out no more.
claim: 성도들은 악한 사람들의 적개심에도 불구하고 그들의 증오가 더 많이 폭발하지 않는 것에 대해 감사해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Had not God so bound man- kind together, that they cannot obtain their own ends without be- ing civil and kind to others, where there is one instance of bitter persecution, we might expect a hundred ; and the same may be said of every other species of malevolence.
claim: 인간이 자신의 목적을 달성하기 위해 다른 사람에게 친절하게 행동해야 하는 것은 하나님의 섭리 덕분에 가능하다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But, though such a constitution of things furnishes matter for thankfulness, yet it is utterly inadequate to the producing of peace on earth, and goodwill to men.
claim: 인간의 평화와 우호는 물질적인 조건이나 편익으로만은 달성될 수 없다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Stifled animosity is very different from love ; the good understanding which arises from it, is not peace but the mere suspension of hostilities for the sake of con- venience.
claim: 인간의 이해와 편익을 위한 잠재된 적개심의 억제는 참된 사랑과 평화와는 다르다.
claim_raw: 인간의 이해와 편익을 위한 잠재된 적개심의 억제는真正한 사랑과 평화와는 다르다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It has been said, that the only thing necessary to pro- duce universal peace is, that mankind be enlightened to know their true interests.
claim: 인간이 자신의 진정한 이익을 알게 되면 만물의 평화를 이룰 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Certain it is, that if our true interests were known and pursued, we should seek the good of mankind in all that we have to do with them : but sin, operating in a wqy of selfishness, blinds the mind, and prompts men to seek their own interest, in opposition to that of others.
claim: 인간이 참된 이익을 알게 되고 추구하게 되면, 모든 사람의 선을 추구하게 되지만, 죄는 이기주의로 작용하여 사람들의 마음을 어둡게 하여 다른 사람의 이익에 반대되는 자기 이익을 추구하도록 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Such also is the strength of corrupt propensity in men, that in many cases, which must appear to be injurious to themselves, as well as others, they will frequently give way to it, whatever be the consequence, and even ruin themselves for the sake of ruining their neighbours.
claim: 인간의 부패한 성향은 자아를 파괴하고 이웃을 해칠 정도로 강력하여, 개인과 타인 모두에게 유익하지 않은 경우에도 그 성향에 굴복하는 경향이 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is not, therefore, on this ground, that we can rationally build our hope of any essential amelioration of the state of mankind.
claim: 인간의 본성의 부패한 성향은 본인과 타인에게 모두 해가 될 수 있음에도 불구하고, 그들이 종종 그에 굴복하여 심지어 이웃을 파괴하기 위해 스스로를 파괴할 수 있기 때문에, 인간의 상태의 본질적인 개선에 대한 우리의 희망을 합리적으로 세울 수 있는 근거는 아님

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: This is, doubtless, an important blessing to mankind.
claim: 인간에게 정부는 중요한 축복이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is among the means by which God, in his providence, preserves the world in some degree of order.
claim: 하나님의 섭리에는 세계를 어느 정도 질서 있게 유지하는 수단이 포함되어 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The pence of the governed, so far as it respects one another, is hereby in a measure, secured.
claim: 하나님의 섭리 가운데서 법은 통치받는 자들이 서로에 대한 평화를 어느 정도 보장받을 수 있도록 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The short duration of suffer- ing ordinarily renders it tolerable, even though, for a time, it may be acute 5 and, if succeeded by lasting enjoyment, we consider it unmanly to make much of it ; and if it be in the service of a beloved sovereign, and in support of a cause of great importance, and which lies near the heart, it is usually treated as a matter of still less account.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is in this way that the great God expresses his infinite superiority to the most exalted creatures : Who in the heavens can be compared unto the Lord? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto Je- hovah?
claim: 하나님은 가장 높은 창조물보다도 훨씬 더 우월하신 분이다.

author: Andrew Fuller

author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: He could have stopped the machinery of the material world, and at once have put an end to the rebellion ; but he thought fit to order the laws of nature to keep their course ; and, as to the abuse that man would make of them, he should be called to account for that another day.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: God, in his infinite wisdom, saw fit to subject the creatures to this vanity for a season, contrary as it was to their nature; but it is only for a season, and therefore is said to be in hope; in the end, they that have abused them will, except they repent, be punished, and they themselves be liberated from their hateful yoke.
claim: 하나님은 그의 무한한 지혜로 창조물을 한시즌 동안 이 헛된 상태에 맡기셨지만, 이것은 창조물의 본성에 반대되는 것이었고, 오직 한시즌 동안이며, 그러므로 희망 안에서 말한 것이며, 결국에 이들을 오용한 자들은 회개하지 않으면 벌을 받을 것이며, 창조물들은 그들을 싫어하는 멍에에서 해방될 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Thus, for a season, he subjected the seed of Abraham, his own servants, to serve the Egyptians ; but that nation, says he, tohom they shall serve, will I judge ; and afterward shall they come oat with great substmice.
claim: 하나님은 그의 지혜로 창조물을 한시즌 동안 헛된 것에 복종시키셨지만, 그 시즌이 끝나면 그들이 악용한 자들은 회개하지 않으면 벌을 받고, 창조물들은 그 싫어하는 멍에에서 해방될 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The time fixed for the deliverance of the creatures from the bondage of corruption, is that of the manifestation of the sons of God.
claim: 창조물이 부패의 속박에서 해방되는 시기는 하나님의 아들들의 나타남의 때이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Hence, they are in a manner identified with them : The earnest expectation of the creature waiiethfor the manifestation of the sons of God; looking for it as for their own deliverance.
claim: 창조물의 구원은 하나님의 아들들의 나타남과 관련이 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The redemption of our bodies from the grave will be the destruction of the last enemy, or, in respect of believers, the termination of the effects of sin : and, as the thraldom of the creatures commen- ced with the commencement of sin, it is fit that it should terminate with its termination.
claim: 믿는 자들의 몸의 부활은 마지막 적인 사망을 파괴하는 것이며, 믿는 자들에 관하여는 죄의 영향의 종결이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Thus our resurrection will be the signal of emancipation to the creatures, and their emancipation will mag- nify the glory that shall be revealed in us.
claim: 그리스도인의 부활은 창조물의 해방을 알리는 신호가 될 것이며, 창조물의 해방은 우리 안에 나타날 영광을 더욱 크게 할 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Heaven, earth, and seas, and all that in them is, will no longer be worshipped in the place of God, nor compelled to minister to his enemies ; but, in that renovated state wherein dwelleth righteous?iess, shall exist but to praise and glorify their Creator.
claim: 하늘과 땅과 바다, 그리고 그 안에 있는 모든 것이 더 이상 하나님 대신 예배의 대상이 되지 않고, 그의 적들을 섬기도록 강요받지 않을 것이며, 의가 거하는 새로워진 상태에서 창조주를 찬양하고 영광을 돌리기 위해 존재할 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Assuredly, that must be a most important object, the accomplishment of which thus interests the whole creation.
claim: 창조물의 관심을 끌고 있는 목적은 매우 중요하다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: This object is the glory that shall be revealed in us — the manifestation of the sons of God — the glorious liberty of the children of God ; and thus it is that the Apos- tle establishes his position — That such is the magnitude of the in- heritance of believers, that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy to be compared with it.
claim: 믿는 자들의 유업은 현재의 고난과 비교할 수 없을 정도로 거대하며, 이는 하나님의 자녀들의 영광스러운 자유와 하나님의 아들들의 나타남에 관한 것이다.
claim_raw: 믿는 자들의 유업은 현재의 고난과 비교할 수 없을 정도로伟大하며, 이는 하나님의 자녀들의 영광스러운 자유와 하나님의 아들들의 나타남에 관한 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But we must not dismiss this part of the subject, without no- ticing more particularly these descriptions of the heavenly inher- itance— the glory to be revealed in us — the manifestation of the sons of God — and the glorious liberty of the children of God, They all refer to the perfecting of salvation through the death of Christ, which is the greatest display of the glory of God that ever has or will be made.
claim: 그리스도의 죽음으로 말미암는 구원의 완성은 하나님의 영광의 가장 큰 드러남이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: This is the last of that series of events which have been carrying on from the beginning of the world, and to the accomplishment of which they have all been subordi- nate.
claim: 세계의 시작부터 진행되어 온 일련의 사건들은 모두 그 완성을 위해 종속되어 왔으며, 그 마지막 사건은 그 완성을 이루는 것

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The glory that shall be revealed in us. — There will, doubtless, be a flood of light and joy that will then open to our admiring minds ; but the words seem rather to denote the manifestation of the divine glory in our salvation than barely its being revealed to us.
claim: 우리의 구원에서 신의 영광이 나타날 것

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Thus the Lord Jesus will come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe.
claim: 주 예수께서 성도들 안에서 영광을 받으시고 모든 믿는 이들 안에서 감상받으실 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The great Physician will appear, with his recovered millions, and, in the presence of an assembled universe, will present them to the Father.
claim: 주님은 회복된 수백만 명을 데리고 나타나서, 우주가 모인 앞에서 아버지께 그들을 제시하실 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Thus the glory of God will be revealed to the universe in our salvation.
claim: 구원으로 말미암아 하나님의 영광이 우주에 나타날 것

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: All his glorious perfections will be manifested in such a light as they never were by any other of his works, nor by this till it was completed.
claim: 하나님의 모든 영광스러운 완전함이 다른 작품이나 아직 완성되지 않은 이 구원으로 인해 이전에 나타난 것보다 더 밝게 나타날 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: And that which is revealed to the universe in us will not be less, but more of an enjoyment to us, than if it had been revealed to us only.
claim: 우주에 계시된 하나님의 영광은 우리에게 직접 계시된 것만큼이나 큰 기쁨을 줄 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The joy of the returned captives was not diminished, but increased, by the surrounding nations saying, The Lord hath done great things for them !
claim: 다른 사람들의 인정과 칭찬이 우리의 기쁨을 증가시킨다
claim_raw: 他の 사람들의 인정과 칭찬이 우리의 기쁨을 증가시킨다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The manifestation of the sons of God. — The foregoing descrip- tion of the heavenly inheritance had respect to God's manifesting his glory ; this to his manifesting ours.
claim: 하나님의 아들들의 나타남은 하나님의 영광을 나타내는 것과 관련이 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Even an inspired Apostle was overwhelmed in thinking of it, and con- fessed his ignorance : Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the so?is of God ! there- fore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
claim: 하나님의 사랑의 크기를 이해하는 것은 매우 어렵다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Beloved, 7ioto are we the sons of God ; and it doth not yet appear what we shall be : but we knoio that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him ; for we shall see him as he is!
claim: 신자들은 현재 자신들이 될 것의 모든 것을 알지 못하지만, 주님께서 나타나실 때 그분과 같은 모습이 될 것이라는 사실을 압니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Then the importance of be- ing heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ, will be apparent.
claim: 하나님의 상속자이자 그리스도와 함께 상속받는 자가 되는 것이 중요하다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The sons of God have here been but little known.
claim: 하나님의 아들들은 이곳에서 거의 알려지지 않았다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Not being distinguished by any thing pertaining to circumstances, or out- ward condition, and that which has distinguished them being of a still and unostentatious nature, they have generally passed through the world without attracting much of its notice, unless it were to despise and persecute them.
claim: 하나님의 아들들은 외적인 조건이나 상황으로 인해 구별되지 않으며, 그들이 구별되는 것은 조용하고 외적인 것이 아니기 때문에, 일반적으로 세상을 통해 거의 주목을 받지 않고 지나가며, 때로는 멸시와 박해를 받았다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If they have been acknowledged as pious men, and have escaped the persecutions and reproaches of the wicked, yet, being mostly poor, and undistinguished by bril- liancy of talent, they have ordinarily been considered as beneath attention.
claim: 거룩한 삶을 산 사람들은 세상에서 주목받지 못하고 가난하고 재능이 출중하지 않아 대개 무시당하지만, 최후의 심판에서 주님은 그들을 구별하여 그의 아버지의 복된 자들로 인정할 것이다.
claim_raw: 거룩한 삶을 산 사람들은 세상에서 주목받지 못하고貧困하고 재능이 출중하지 않아 대개 무시당하지만, 최후의 심판에서 주님은 그들을 구별하여 그의 아버지의 복된 자들로 인정할 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But, at that day, the Judge of heaven and earth will distinguish them as the sheep that he will place at his right hand} and as the blessed of his Father, whom he will welcome to the kingdom prepared for them from the foundation of the world ; while those who have despised and persecuted them, shall be sentenced to everlasting punishment.
claim: 마지막 날에 하늘과 땅의 판관은 그들을 그의 오른쪽에 두어 아버지의 복된 자로 받아들이고, 그들에게 준비된 왕국에 들어가게 하실 것이며, 그들을 멸시하고 핍박한 자들은 영원한 형벌을 받을 것

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The glorious liberty of the children of God. — The children of God have possessed a glorious liberty from their first believing in Christ.
claim: 하나님의 자녀들은 그리스도에게 처음 믿음으로부터 영광스러운 자유를 소유한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The son then made them free, and they were free in- deed !
claim: 그리스도에게 처음으로 믿음을 가진 자들은 영광스러운 자유를 소유한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: And when the earthly house of their tabernacle is dissol- ved, and they are received among the spirits of just men made per- fect, this is a liberty more glorious.
claim: 믿는 자들의 영적 자유는 그들의 육신의 집이 해체되고 의인들의 영혼과 함께 완전하게 될 때 더욱 영광스럽게 이루어진다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But, while their bodies are imprisoned in the grave, the deliverance i? not complete.
claim: 그리스도인의 몸이 무덤에 갇혀 있는 동안 구원은 완전하지 않다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: They are, as yet, under thraldom.
claim: 그들의 몸은 아직 무덤에 갇혀 있기 때문에, 구원은 아직 완전하지 않다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The promise of Christ to raise us up at the last day is yet unfulfilled.
claim: 그리스도의 마지막 날에 우리를 일으키시겠다는 약속은 아직 이루어지지 않았다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: from the dominion of sin, and from the existence of it in their minds ; but not from its effects.
claim: 그리스도인들은 죄의 지배와 그들의 마음속에서의 존재로부터 자유로워지지만, 죄의 영향으로부터는 자유로워지지 않는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It is reserved for the second coming of Christ, when he will come -without sin unto salvation, to accomplish this.
claim: 그리스도의 재림 때에만 죄의 존재에서 완전히 해방될 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: This is the destruction of the last enemy ; this, therefore, puts an end to the war.
claim: 그리스도의 재림은 마지막 적, 즉 사망을 파괴하고 전쟁을 끝낼 것

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: In the account of Christ's second coming, there appears to be an allusion to the blowing of the trumpet of jubilee, and the liberation of the captives: The Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first : then, we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
claim: 그리스도의 재림은 구원받은 자들에게는 자유와 해방의 날이 될 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The resurrection, then, will be to believers a jubilee, a day of deliverance.
claim: 부활은 믿는 자들에게 해방의 날인 주빌리이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The account of it, by the same Apostle in the 15th chapter of his First Epistle to the Corinthians, gives us the triumphant song which be- lievers shall sing, standing over the graves in which they have been so long imprisoned : O death where is thy sting ? 0 gravt where is thy victory ?
claim: 부활은 믿는 자들에게 해방의 날이 될 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The sting of death is sin ; and the strength of sin is the law.
claim: 사망의 가시는 죄이며, 죄의 세력은 법이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But thanks be to God, who giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
claim: 하나님은 우리 주 예수 그리스도를 통해 우리에게 승리를 주신다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: This is the glorious liberty of the children of God, in which the whole creation shall partici- pate.
claim: 하나님의 자녀들은 영광스러운 자유를 가지고 있으며, 이는 모든 창조물이 참여할 것이라는 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: SUCH IS THE MAGNITUDE OF THE GLORY TO BE REVEALED IN US AT THE RESURRECTION, THAT THOSE CHRISTIANS WHO HAVE POSSESSED THE HIGHEST ENJOYMENTS IN THIS WORLD WERE NOT SATISFIED WITH THEM ; BUT GROANED WITHIN THEMSELVES, WAIT- ING FOR the possession of it.
claim: 그리스도인들은 이 세상의 최고의 즐거움을 경험했어도, 부활 때 나타날 영광을 기다리며 속으로 탄식한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: And not only they, (the crea- tures,) but ourselves also, — even we ourselves groan within our- selves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
claim: 그리스도인들은 현재의 최고의 즐거움에도 만족하지 못하고, 몸의 구속에서 해방되는 부활의 날을 기다리며 내적으로 탄식한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: By toe ourselves, I understand the Apostle to mean, not believ- ers in general, but those believers in his own times, who, with him- •self, possessed so large a measure of grace and peace as habitually to rejoice in the Lord.
claim: 사도는 일반적인 신자들이 아니라, 그 시대의 신자들, 즉 자신과 함께 큰 은혜와 평화를 받았고 주님을 기뻐하는 신자들을 말한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: They did not merely rejoice not- withstanding the persecutions which they met with, but in them : They departed from the presence of the council, (where they had been beaten.) rejoicing that they were counted toorthy to suffer shame for his name.
claim: 그들은 박해를 받음에도 불구하고 기뻐했으며, 그 박해 안에서 기뻐했다. 그들은 의회 앞에서 떠나면서 그의 이름으로 수치심을 겪는 데 합당한 자로 여겨지는 것을 기뻐했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: These good men seem to have found heaven upon earth.
claim: 이 선한 사람들이 땅에서 천국을 발견했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 7: Sermons on Various Subjects
